blurb: Guests learn partner and solo dance skills in a structured curriculum designed for adults, starting with intro classes and bootcamps, progressing through multiple levels. Classes include social dance opportunities and practice labs to build confidence and technique. Memberships and passes offer flexible attendance options from drop-ins to unlimited monthly plans.
